CONNECT YOUR SOURCES +

Import a sample CSV here. The full platform is designed for REST, MQTT and read-only OPC UA through an edge connector.

MAP EVERY SIGNAL +

Assign each reading a machine, component, sensor, timestamp and unit. Consistent mapping makes drill-down and historical comparison possible.

CHECK DATA QUALITY +

Missing, delayed, duplicate and stale data must remain visible. A disconnected sensor should never imply a healthy machine.

KEEP DATA MOVING +

The planned edge service buffers readings during an outage and reports gateway health. This landing-page demo runs locally in your browser.

VIEW CALCULATIONS & LIMITS +

Output is the minimum of demand and bottleneck capacity, adjusted for downtime. Station cycles: cutting 8 s, drilling as selected, assembly 11 s, inspection 7 s, packaging 9 s. A second drill divides drilling's effective cycle by two. This is a steady-state capacity illustration, not a discrete-event production forecast. It excludes queues, startup time, routing losses, failure distributions, energy and cost.
